# Homie Cozie Coffee & Kitchen — Full Digital Knowledge Base & Specifications

## 1. Identitas & Profil Bisnis
- Nama Usaha: Homie Cozie Coffee & Kitchen
- Tagline: Tempat Nongkrong Hangat & Live Music Favorit Kalisari – Cijantung
- Tahun Berdiri: 2020 (6 Tahun Melayani Komunitas)
- Alamat Lengkap: Jl. H. Hasan No. 23, RT.5/RW.2, Baru, Kec. Pasar Rebo, Kota Jakarta Timur, DKI Jakarta 13780
- Titik Koordinat: -6.3255424, 106.8499976 (Google Plus Code: MRFX+QX Baru, Kota Jakarta Timur)
- Rating Google Maps: 4.8 / 5.0 (268+ Ulasan Terverifikasi)
- WhatsApp Reservasi / Hotline: +62 878-5004-9458
- Telepon Kafe: 0815-8640-2420
- Media Sosial: Instagram @homie.cozie, Linktree linktr.ee/homie.cozie
- Jam Operasional:
  * Selasa – Minggu: 10:00 – 23:00 WIB
  * Akhir Pekan (Jumat – Minggu): 09:00 – 00:00 WIB (Live Acoustic Music mulai 19:30 WIB)
  * Hari Senin: Libur Operasional (Maintenance)

## 2. Fasilitas Kafe
- Panggung Live Music Akustik (Semi-Outdoor Stage)
- Indoor Utama Full AC & Bebas Asap Rokok
- Semi-Outdoor Seating Area (Smoking Friendly)
- Mezzanine Cozy Floor (Semi-Private Lantai Atas)
- Wi-Fi 100 Mbps Berkecepatan Tinggi (SSID: HomieCozie_Guest)
- Colokan Listrik (Power Outlet) Tersedia di Setiap Meja
- Area Parkir Luas untuk Motor dan Mobil
- Musholla Bersih dan Toilet Nyaman
- Boardgames & Permainan Kartu (Uno, Chess, Stacko)

## 3. Daftar Menu & Harga Utama (100% Halal)
- Kopi Susu Homie Signature (Rp 24.000) — Espresso blend pilihan + gula aren murni + susu segar gurih
- Aren Cremosa Cozie (Rp 28.000) — Double espresso + salted caramel cream + torched brown sugar
- V60 Single Origin (Rp 30.000) — Biji kopi arabika pilihan: Aceh Gayo Natural, Flores Bajawa Washed, Kerinci Honey
- Butterscotch Sea Salt Latte (Rp 29.000) — Espresso + butterscotch sauce + sea salt foam
- Matcha Cold Whisk Latte (Rp 27.000) — Pure Uji matcha grade ceremonial + fresh milk
- Tropical Berry Fizz Mocktail (Rp 26.000) — Mixed berries compote + soda + mint leaves
- Artisan Earl Grey Milk Tea (Rp 25.000) — Premium black tea with bergamot oil + steamed milk
- Nasi Goreng Homie Spesial (Rp 35.000) — Nasi goreng resep rumahan + telur mata sapi + kerupuk + ayam suwir
- Spaghetti Aglio Olio Smoked Beef (Rp 34.000) — Pasta al dente + olive oil + bawang putih + smoked beef + cabe kering
- Crispy Chicken Sambal Matah Rice Bowl (Rp 32.000) — Ayam krispi gurih + sambal matah Bali segar + nasi pulen
- Beef Quesadilla with Mozzarella (Rp 33.000) — Tortilla panggang isi daging sapi cincang bumbu rempah + lelehan keju mozarella
- Churros con Chocolate / Dulce de Leche (Rp 23.000) — Churros renyah bertabur cinnamon sugar + cocolan cokelat premium
- Croffle Maple Butter Glaze (Rp 25.000) — Croissant waffle renyah berlapis karamel + topping butter & maple syrup

## 4. Sistem Digital & Integrasi
- Progressive Web App (PWA) Offline-Ready dengan Service Worker
- QR Table Ordering & Pembayaran QRIS Dinamis Bank Indonesia
- Live Order Kitchen Display System (KDS) & Real-time POS Kasir
- Integrasi Real-time Pusher WebSockets & Web Audio Sound Chimes
- Manajemen Bill of Materials (BOM) & Pengurangan Stok Otomatis
